seo.title: Clint — Blacksmith
seo.description: Forges tools at the smithy and harbors a crush on Emily. Gems and ore keep the conversation going.

stardew.intro: The town blacksmith — awkward, earnest, and shy around Emily. Upgrade your tools through him as the farm grows.

relationships.name: Emily
relationships.note: Has a crush he cannot quite express — shows up at the saloon on her nights.

relationships.name: Robin
relationships.note: Supplies materials for farm buildings and tool upgrades.

trivia: Any refined gem is loved — drop a topaz or aquamarine from the mines for easy friendship.
